title: South Korea’s Monthly Exports Hit Record as Chip Boom Rolls on
description: South Korea’s exports extended their breakneck growth in September as global demand for artificial intelligence continued to power semiconductor shipments, reinforcing expectations that the trade-dependent economy can withstand higher interest rates.

title: Nidec Shares Plunge After Auditor Withholds Opinion on Earnings
description: Nidec Corp. shares dropped as much as 20% in Tokyo after the Japanese motor maker’s auditor declined to give an opinion on its long-awaited full-year results, fueling caution over the scandal-hit company.

title: Micron Gives Bullish Forecast, Warns on Margins
description: Micron Technology Inc. gave an upbeat forecast for the current quarter, fueled by the AI building frenzy, though the chipmaker warned that rising compensation would weigh on profit margins. Bloomberg Intelligence's Jake Silverman has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
